name: Johan Van Overtveldt - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the European Central Bank – annual report 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how the European Central Bank should run monetary policy. It says the bank must stay independent and focused on keeping prices stable, and it asks the bank to explain the causes of recent high inflation and to be careful about further interest rate cuts. It also asks the bank to shrink its government bond purchases, be more transparent, and keep cash available. The report is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only gives its opinion and asks the bank to act.
- **Who it affects:** The European Central Bank, banks, and people using the euro.
- **What happens next:** The report goes to the Council and Commission; the bank decides whether to follow it.
